source.pages: Sick child 2 months up to 5 years: printed pages 09-11 (PDF pages 11-13)
source.retrieved_note: nhm.gov.in refused connections from the build machine (2026-10-13). This copy is hosted by NHM Mizoram (state National Health Mission). Cover reads 'Chart Booklet for Health Workers, Child Health Division, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India, 2023'. Compare the SHA-256 with a copy downloaded from nhm.gov.in.

IMPORTANT.verification: Each classification carries verified and source_check. verified:true only with a real printed page and an exact quote from the 2023 health-worker booklet. Quotes are whitespace-normalised.

source_check_methods.ai-compared-to-booklet: Compared to the booklet by software (Claude), with page and quote. Not reviewed by a clinician.
source_check_methods.clinician-reviewed: Reviewed against the printed booklet by a named clinician, with reviewer and date. Set only by hand or by scripts/apply-review.ts from that clinician's exported /review file.
source_check_methods.not-confirmed: Not found in, or not readable from, the booklet. Has a reason.

IMPORTANT.check_scope: A source_check covers the signs, thresholds, colour band and follow_up_days of a row. asha_action and refer are ASHA-scope filters and are NOT checked against this booklet: its treatment column is written for health workers (ANMs), not ASHAs. Confirm them against the NHM ASHA drug kit list.
IMPORTANT.scope: imnci_action is the booklet's treatment column, much of which (injectables, gentamicin, antimalarials) is outside ASHA scope. The app shows asha_action only.
IMPORTANT.role: This encodes a referral and triage protocol. It classifies and routes. It does not diagnose and must never be presented as diagnosis.

colour_bands.pink: Urgent referral. Complete assessment, give any permitted pre-referral treatment, refer immediately.
colour_bands.yellow: Treat with a specific medicine or advice and follow up on a stated day.
colour_bands.green: Home care and counselling. Advise when to return immediately.

source_check.quote: A child with any general danger sign needs URGENT attention

ask.question_en: Is the child able to drink or feed?
ask.question_hi: क्या बच्चा पी या खा पा रहा है?
क्या बच्चा जो भी खाता-पीता है, सब उल्टी कर देता है?
क्या बच्चे को झटके या दौरे आए हैं?

look.observation_en: See if the child is lethargic or unconscious
look.observation_hi: क्या बच्चा सुस्त है या बेहोश है?

look.observation_en: Is the child convulsing now?
look.observation_hi: क्या बच्चे को अभी झटके आ रहे हैं?

general_danger_signs.rule: A child with any general danger sign needs URGENT attention; complete the assessment and any pre-referral treatment immediately so that referral is not delayed.
general_danger_signs.asha_action: Refer urgently to the nearest facility. Keep the child warm. Continue breastfeeding if the child can drink. Do not delay referral to finish other questions.

trigger.question_en: Does the child have cough or difficult breathing?
trigger.question_hi: क्या बच्चे को खाँसी है या साँस लेने में तकलीफ़ है?

look.observation_en: Count the breaths in one minute
look.observation_hi: एक मिनट तक बच्चे की साँसें गिनिए

look.observation_en: Look for chest indrawing
look.observation_hi: साँस लेते समय क्या बच्चे की छाती नीचे की ओर धँसती है?

look.observation_en: Check oxygen saturation with the pulse oximeter. What is the reading in percent?
look.observation_hi: Pulse oximeter से oxygen saturation देखिए। कितने प्रतिशत है?

fast_breathing.description: Age-dependent threshold. Lower bound inclusive, upper bound exclusive.

classifications.name: SEVERE PNEUMONIA OR VERY SEVERE DISEASE
classifications.imnci_action: Give pre-referral dose of oral amoxycillin & IM gentamicin. Refer URGENTLY to hospital.
classifications.asha_action: Refer URGENTLY to the nearest facility. Keep the child warm and continue breastfeeding if possible. Do not wait.

classifications.name: PNEUMONIA
classifications.imnci_action: Give amoxycillin for 5 days. Advise home care for cough and cold. Follow-up after 2 days.
classifications.asha_action: Amoxicillin is required. If it is not in your kit, refer to the sub-centre or PHC the same day for treatment. Advise home care for cough and cold, and when to return immediately.

classifications.name: NO PNEUMONIA: COUGH OR COLD
classifications.imnci_action: Advise home care for cough and cold. If coughing for more than 14 days, refer for assessment. Follow up after 5 days, if not improving.
classifications.asha_action: Home care for cough and cold. Counsel the mother on danger signs. Follow up in 5 days if not improving. If the cough has lasted more than 14 days, refer for assessment.

escalate_if.then: refer for assessment (cough for more than 14 days)

source_check.quote: If coughing for more than 14 days, refer for assessment

trigger.question_hi: क्या बच्चे को दस्त हो रहे हैं?

ask.question_en: Is there blood in the stool?
ask.question_hi: क्या दस्त में खून आ रहा है?

look.observation_en: Is the child lethargic or unconscious?
look.observation_hi: क्या बच्चा सुस्त है या बेहोश है?

look.observation_en: Is the child restless and irritable?
look.observation_hi: क्या बच्चा बेचैन है या चिड़चिड़ा है?

look.observation_en: Look for sunken eyes
look.observation_hi: क्या बच्चे की आँखें धँसी हुई हैं?

look.observation_en: Offer the child fluid: not able to drink or drinking poorly?
look.observation_hi: बच्चे को पीने को दीजिए: क्या वह पी नहीं पा रहा या बहुत कम पी रहा है?

look.observation_en: Offer the child fluid: drinking eagerly, thirsty?
look.observation_hi: बच्चे को पीने को दीजिए: क्या वह प्यास से जल्दी-जल्दी पी रहा है?

look.observation_en: Pinch the skin of the abdomen: does it go back very slowly (longer than 2 seconds)?
look.observation_hi: पेट की त्वचा चुटकी से पकड़कर छोड़िए: क्या वह बहुत धीरे (2 सेकंड से ज़्यादा में) वापस जाती है?

look.observation_en: Pinch the skin of the abdomen: does it go back slowly?
look.observation_hi: पेट की त्वचा चुटकी से पकड़कर छोड़िए: क्या वह धीरे वापस जाती है?

classification_groups.note: Severe and some dehydration each require TWO OR MORE of their listed signs.

escalate_if.then: refer to hospital (blood in stool or diarrhoea 14 days or more)

source_check.quote: If blood in stool or diarrhoea ≥ 14 days, refer to hospital.

classifications.name: SEVERE DEHYDRATION
classifications.imnci_action: Refer URGENTLY to hospital with mother giving frequent sips of ORS on the way. Advise the mother to continue breastfeeding.
classifications.asha_action: Refer URGENTLY. Start ORS immediately and have the mother give frequent sips on the way. Continue breastfeeding.

source_check.quote: Refer URGENTLY to hospital with mother giving frequent sips of ORS on the way.

classifications.name: SOME DEHYDRATION
classifications.imnci_action: Give fluids, zinc supplements and food for some dehydration (Plan B). Follow-up after 2 days if not improving. Advice when to return immediately.
classifications.asha_action: Give ORS and zinc. Counsel the mother on how to give ORS at home and on danger signs. Follow up after 2 days if not improving. Refer if the child worsens or cannot keep fluids down.

source_check.quote: Follow-up after 2 days if not improving.

classifications.name: NO DEHYDRATION
classifications.imnci_action: Give fluids, zinc supplements and food to treat diarrhoea at home (Plan A). Follow-up after 5 days if not improving. Advice when to return immediately.
classifications.asha_action: Plan A at home: extra fluids, ORS, zinc, continue feeding. Counsel on danger signs. Follow up after 5 days if not improving.

source_check.quote: Not enough signs to classify as some or severe dehydration.

trigger.question_en: Does the child have fever? (by history, feels hot, or temperature 37.5 C or above)
trigger.question_hi: क्या बच्चे को बुखार है? (माँ ने बताया हो, छूने पर गरम लगे, या तापमान 37.5 डिग्री या ज़्यादा हो)

context.note: The booklet asks 'Is it a PF (p. falciparum) predominant area? Yes/No'. It decides whether an RDT is done in every fever case, not which row applies. Not modelled by the engine.

ask.question_en: Has the fever been present every day?
ask.question_hi: क्या बुखार हर दिन रहा है?

look.observation_en: Look or feel for stiff neck
look.observation_hi: क्या बच्चे की गर्दन अकड़ी हुई है?

look.observation_en: Look for any other focus of fever, such as cough or cold, pneumonia, diarrhoea, dysentery, skin infection, dengue or measles
look.observation_hi: क्या बुखार का कोई और कारण दिख रहा है, जैसे खाँसी-ज़ुकाम, निमोनिया, दस्त, पेचिश, त्वचा का संक्रमण, डेंगू या खसरा?
look.source_quote: Look for any other focus of fever

look.observation_en: Do an RDT for malaria. Is it positive, negative, or is RDT not available?
look.observation_hi: मलेरिया की RDT जाँच कीजिए। क्या वह positive है, negative है, या RDT उपलब्ध नहीं है?
look.source_quote: Do RDT for malaria in all fever cases if it is PF predominant area and if no obvious cause of fever is present in other areas or malaria suspected

classifications.name: VERY SEVERE FEBRILE DISEASE
classifications.imnci_action: Give first dose of oral amoxycillin and IM gentamicin. Treat the child to prevent low blood sugar. Give one dose of paracetamol for high fever (temp. 38.5 C/101.3 F or above). Refer URGENTLY to hospital.
classifications.asha_action: Refer URGENTLY. These are facility treatments, not ASHA actions. Keep the child warm, continue breastfeeding if the child can drink, and do not delay transport.

source_check.quote: Any general danger sign or Stiff Neck

classifications.name: MALARIA/ SUSPECTED MALARIA
classifications.imnci_action: Give oral antimalarial as per national guidelines after making a smear. Give one dose of paracetamol in clinic for high fever (temp. 38.5 C/101.3 F or above). Advise mother when to return immediately. Follow-up after 2 days.
classifications.asha_action: Antimalarial treatment as per national guidelines is needed. If you are not trained and supplied for it, refer the same day. Paracetamol for high fever. Advise the mother when to return immediately. Follow up after 2 days.

source_check.quote: Positive RDT or RDT not available and no other obvious cause of fever

classifications.name: FEVER - MALARIA UNLIKELY
classifications.imnci_action: Give one dose of paracetamol in clinic for high fever (temp. 38.5 C/101.3 F or above). Give appropriate treatment for an identified cause of fever. Advise mother when to return immediately. Follow-up after 2 days if fever persists. If fever is present every day for more than 7 days, refer for assessment.
classifications.asha_action: Paracetamol for high fever. Look after the other cause of fever as you are trained to, or refer for it. Advise the mother when to return immediately. Follow up after 2 days if the fever persists.

escalate_if.then: refer for assessment (fever every day for more than 7 days)

source_check.quote: Negative RDT and/or other causes of fever PRESENT

look.observation_en: Measure weight and length or height, plot weight-for-length on the MCP card. Is it red, yellow or green? Say 'not measured' if you could not measure.
look.observation_hi: वज़न और लंबाई नापकर MCP card पर weight-for-length देखिए। लाल, पीला या हरा? अगर नाप नहीं पाए तो बताइए।
look.note: MCP card colours: red is WFL < -3 SD, yellow is WFL < -2 SD, green is WFL >= -2 SD.

look.observation_en: Look for visible severe wasting
look.observation_hi: क्या बच्चा देखने में बहुत ज़्यादा दुबला, सूखा हुआ है?

look.observation_en: Look for oedema of both feet
look.observation_hi: क्या बच्चे के दोनों पैरों में सूजन है?

look.observation_en: Measure MUAC (mid-upper arm circumference). How many cm?
look.observation_hi: MUAC tape से बच्चे की बाँह नापिए। कितने cm है?

look.observation_en: Look for palmar pallor. Is it severe, some, or none?
look.observation_hi: बच्चे की हथेली देखिए। क्या वह बहुत ज़्यादा पीली है, थोड़ी पीली है, या सामान्य है?

classifications.name: SEVERE ACUTE MALNUTRITION
classifications.imnci_action: Give first dose of oral amoxycillin and IM gentamicin. Treat the child to prevent low blood sugar. Refer URGENTLY to hospital. Keep the child warm on the way to hospital.
classifications.asha_action: Refer URGENTLY. Keep the child warm on the way to hospital. Continue breastfeeding or feeding if the child can take it.

source_check.quote: WFL <-3 SD score (red color on MCP card)* and/or MUAC <11.5 cm and/or Oedema of both feet

classifications.name: MODERATE ACUTE MALNUTRITION
classifications.imnci_action: Assess feeding and counsel the mother on how to feed the child. Advise mother when to return immediately. Follow-up after 30 days.
classifications.asha_action: Assess feeding and counsel the mother on how to feed the child. Advise when to return immediately. Follow up after 30 days.

source_check.quote: WFL <-2 SD score (yellow color on MCP card) and/or MUAC 11.5–12.4 cm and No Oedema of both feet

classifications.name: NO ACUTE MALNUTRITION
classifications.imnci_action: If child is less than 2 years old, assess the child's feeding and counsel the mother on feeding according to the FOOD box on the COUNSEL THE MOTHER chart. If feeding problem, follow-up in 5 days. Advise mother when to return immediately.
classifications.asha_action: If the child is under 2 years, assess feeding and counsel the mother. If there is a feeding problem, follow up in 5 days. Advise when to return immediately.

source_check.quote: WFL ≥ -2SD score and MUAC ≥ 12.5 cm and No Oedema of both feet

classifications.name: ANEMIA
classifications.imnci_action: Give iron folic acid therapy for 14 days. Assess the child's feeding and counsel the mother on feeding. If feeding problem, follow-up after 5 days. Follow-up after 14 days.
classifications.asha_action: Give paediatric IFA for 14 days. Assess feeding and counsel the mother. Follow up after 14 days, or after 5 days if there is a feeding problem.

source_check.quote: Give iron folic acid therapy for 14 days

classifications.name: NO ANEMIA
classifications.imnci_action: Give prophylactic iron folic acid if child 6 months or older.
classifications.asha_action: If the child is 6 months or older, give prophylactic IFA syrup (1 ml twice a week) after recovery from the acute illness.

source_check.quote: Give prophylactic iron folic acid if child 6 months or older.

classification_order: Check general danger signs FIRST and always.
Then assess each main symptom the child has.
A child can fall into several classifications at once. Use every box that fits.
If ANY pink classification applies, the outcome is urgent referral regardless of the other bands.
